title: Shopee Indonesia Product Search Scraper
description: Scrape product search results from Shopee Indonesia (shopee.co.id). Requires a cookie string from your browser session.

keyword.title: Search Keyword
keyword.description: Search term for Shopee product search (e.g. 'headset gaming')

cookie.title: Shopee Cookie
cookie.description: Raw cookie string from your browser. How to get: Open shopee.co.id → log in → F12 → Application → Cookies → copy all cookies as 'name=value; name2=value2' format

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Number of pages to scrape (each page ~60 items). Max 50.

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Filter products with rating >= this value (0 = no filter)

minPrice.title: Min Price (IDR)
minPrice.description: Minimum price filter in IDR (0 = no filter)

maxPrice.title: Max Price (IDR)
maxPrice.description: Maximum price filter in IDR (0 = no filter)

officialShop.title: Official Shop Only
officialShop.description: Only show products from official/Shopee Mall shops

shopeeVerified.title: Shopee Verified Only
shopeeVerified.description: Only show products from Shopee-verified sellers

location.title: Seller Location
location.description: Filter by seller city (e.g. 'Jakarta', 'Surabaya'). Leave empty for all.
